discoveries:
- A plain collect-only run deselects 13 cases. They are only collected with `--optin=breadth`, which the runner adds by itself.
- `needed_optins` must be given absolute paths. With relative ones it returns `[]`.
- The map has 13 bare `[id]` follow-on items, such as `[the main tree]` or `[gov ci checks G1]`. They are not test names, so they map nothing and fail nothing. I left them as they are; they are outside this task.
- `tools/keyword_warn.py` is not on this branch.

risks: success-1 will read 32/1 every time this case runs inside a launch sandbox. It needs a run outside the sandbox to show green.

lessons: Take a parametrized case's id from a collect-only run with the runner's opt-ins (`--optin=breadth`). Without them, part of the map's cases is never collected.
